references.phrase: inverse image of each quasi-compact open subset
references.context: Set-theoretic preimage f^{-1}(U), required quasi-compact in X; the openness of this preimage follows from continuity

references.phrase: spectral map versus general quasi-compact map
references.disposition: The inverse-image criterion is reused; being a spectral map additionally assumes spectral spaces on both sides.

review_rationale: Read the continuous map between two spectral spaces and the specific quasi-compact-open inverse-image preservation property. The general quasicompact map definition has this same predicate but not the spectral domain and codomain requirements.
